constraints.source: I sleep from 11:30pm to 7:30am on weeknights
constraints.paraphrase: On weeknights (Sun-Thu nights) you sleep 23:30 to 07:30.

constraints.source: on weekends I stay up till 2 and sleep in till 10
constraints.paraphrase: On weekend nights (Fri and Sat nights) you sleep 02:00 to 10:00.
